note: Verdicts are git's own, taken from real files in a real working tree. A file case is kept only when check-ignore, status --ignored and add -n agree. A directory case is asked bare (never with a trailing slash, which would let `d/*` match it via the empty string) and is kept only when check-ignore and a re-inclusion probe agree and nothing staged below contradicts them.
